title: [BUG] Error installing VS Code extension: 1: ENOENT     Please restart your IDE and try again.
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [x] Other: Claude Code
- Claude CLI version: v1.0.1
- Operating System: macOS 15.4
- Terminal:  VSCode Terminal

## Bug Description
```
 Claude Code Status v1.0.1

 Working Directory 
  L /Users/fcoury/code/paypol

 IDE Integration • /config
 ⚠  Error installing VS Code extension: 1: ENOENT
    Please restart your IDE and try again.

 Account • /login
  L Login Method: Claude Max Account (20x)
  L Email: ...

 Memory • /memory
  L project: CLAUDE.md

 Model • /model
  LDefault Uses the best available model for Max usage limits (currently
   Opus)
```

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open VSCode terminal
2. Type claude and enter
3. Type /status

## Expected Behavior
VSCode Extension is Installed

## Actual Behavior
Error installing VS Code extension: 1: ENOENT
    Please restart your IDE and try again.
author: fcoury

top_comments.author: blois
top_comments.body: From the same terminal, does `which code` resolve?  If not, in VSCode can you try running the command `Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH`?

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: What does `code --help` return - is it actually VSCode or any chance it points to Cursor?

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: Thanks for your patience folks. We're tracked down the issue (mostly should impact folks using Fish inside VSCode). The fix should be out shortly, will update again once it's out!
